item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00093","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C02","C10"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 is a strong drafting-template candidate because it concerns the identical legal mechanism: presidential suspension of the eight-hour law for laborers and mechanics when military supply and maintenance require it. The child adapts that machinery to Alaska Railroad rehabilitation and expressly builds toward an extraordinary-emergency finding under the governing eight-hour statute. C02 shares the railroad and essential-transportation setting but uses distinct Railway Labor Act emergency-board machinery. C10 has a somewhat similar recital structure involving statutory suspension and a formal triggering determination, but concerns publication of federal regulations and supplies no material language or machinery specific to the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the service of all laborers and mechanics employed by the Government of the United States upon any public work of the United States is limited to eight hours in any one calendar day except in case of extraordinary emergency","parent_excerpt":"suspends until July 1, 1948, the eight-hour law as to all work performed by laborers and mechanics employed by the Department of the Army or the Department of the Air Force","explanation":"Both directives employ the same eight-hour-law suspension mechanism for government laborers and mechanics."},{"child_excerpt":"the protection of our national security through the maintenance of military posts in Alaska is dependent upon the transportation by the Railroad of vitally needed material, supplies, and equipment for our armed forces","parent_excerpt":"essential to (1) the supply and maintenance of the military or naval forces","explanation":"The child's military-supply justification materially parallels C01's stated criterion for invoking the suspension."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS I find that by reason of the foregoing an extraordinary emergency exists","parent_excerpt":"suspending the eight-hour law","explanation":"The child supplies the emergency finding needed to activate the same substantive exception or suspension reflected in C01."}]}
